topic: Memory Hierarchy and Caching Strategies (Segregated Fits Allocation)
explanation: Memory allocators manage dynamic memory allocation and deallocation.  Segregated fits is a memory management strategy that improves the efficiency of dynamic memory allocation by organizing free memory into segregated lists based on size classes. This reduces search time for suitable blocks during allocation, improving performance compared to searching the entire heap.
